name: Goldsun Building Materials Co Ltd
summary: Goldsun Building Materials Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of premixed concrete and calcium silicate boards throughout Taiwan and mainland China. The company's operations are divided into specific segments, including a Pre-Mixed Concrete division in Taiwan, another Pre-Mixed Concrete division in Mainland China, and several other diversified areas. Beyond its primary building materials production, Goldsun also engages in civil engineering and architectural construction projects. Its extensive service portfolio encompasses global trade, warehousing, transportation, tally and packaging services, interior design, and leisure facility administration. Furthermore, the company imports cement, manages real estate rentals, operates hotels, and distributes a wide array of construction materials. Established in 1954, Goldsun Building Materials Co., Ltd. was formerly known as Goldsun Constructions Co., Ltd. and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
